answer: The saffron multiplier is published, charged in nebula, and garden lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, since the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 16 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 3666 identities would post 2343 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
